messages:
Jordan: NimbusHealth needs a short Dedicated POC. Requirements: a single stable egress IP for their firewall allowlist, and client-cert auth (mTLS). They'd prefer IPv6 but can tolerate IPv4 during the test. Can we do this fast without a Private install?
Lina: Short answer: fastest is Dedicated sandbox + reserved IPv4 egress + customer-side TLS proxy that presents identity to us. Native IPv6 + ingress mTLS needs Private/VPC and longer lead time.
Akash: We also have a managed NAT64 gateway we can enable temporarily so their IPv6-only devices can reach our IPv4 egress IPs. It's not GA but fine for a 3-7 day POC.
Maya: Security wants an auditable handoff. If they terminate mTLS upstream we require either (A) signed X-Client-ID header + timestamp + HMAC, or (B) proxy mTLS -> token exchange with our auth service. We prefer (B) for easier auditing.
Jordan: What about IP stability? They need the IP not to rotate for the week.
Lina: We can mark the reserved NAT IP as non-rotating for the POC window. We'll notify if any cloud provider-level swap is required (24h notice).
Akash: Timeline: Dedicated sandbox + reserved IPv4 egress + NAT64 enabled = ~6 hours. Private sandbox with native IPv6 + ingress mTLS = ~48-72 hours.
Jordan: Pricing/ops: will we bill for this?
Maya: Standard: strategic POCs often get waived platform fees; we bill for SRE time beyond 8 hours of setup. If NAT64 or custom work needed we may add a small ops pass-through.
Akash: Sample token-exchange flow for their proxy:
```bash
# proxy requests token via mTLS
curl --cert /path/proxy.crt --key /path/proxy.key https://auth.redwood.example/v1/token -d 'scope=dedi.poc'
# proxy calls our API with token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://dedi-poc.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Maya: Checklist we need from NimbusHealth: network diagram, CIDRs to allow (if any), whether they will present certs from proxy or directly, proxy cert chain and rotation cadence, emergency revoke contact, and completed security questionnaire. I'll send the questionnaire.
Jordan: Great. Can we spin up the sandbox while they review?
infra-bot: dedicated-sandbox:queued id=dp-900 ETA=6h
Lina: I'll reserve the egress IP and prepare NAT64 DNS instructions + the token example. Akash: please estimate SRE hours so we can include it on the quote.
Akash: will do. Jordan: I'll send NimbusHealth the two-track proposal (fast proxy/NAT64 track vs full Private IPv6 track) and the checklist. Will report back here when they reply.
